sourceNote: I built before committing. Informational metadata retains the baseline head; source and actual assembly hashes identify the measured code.
hostLimits: Default M4 scheduling across both core types, ordinary priority, no affinity or quiet-host claim. Every workload uses heavy-run.lock; builds and native compilation use two workers.

measurement.interpretation: One baseline bracketed by two candidates, not two independent pairs; all losses and earlier trials retained.

harnessIdentity: Each narrow trial uses its candidate harness with both engines. The final bracket uses the identical final candidate harness. The baseline engine and Core stay fixed throughout.
validation: Every implementation materializes all four fields and typed rows, checks every value in preflight, and consumes row counts/checksums during timing. Reader input hashes stay fixed. No data generation, validation adapters or OfficeIMO-only workflow enters the parity timing.

profile.collector: dotnet-trace10.0.750501 sampled-thread-time only, no verbose GC;2 warmups,4 samples,512 invocations per OfficeIMO read/parse case; JIT disassembly diagnostic only. Timings from profiling runs are not ranked. Native inflater throughput is not isolated.
